ko.executive_summary: SMIC's 40.6 billion yuan acquisition of SMIC North cleared regulatory review, consolidating mature-node capacity across the group. The restructuring affects BCD process availability and supply chain logistics for downstream PMIC customers, though specific capacity or utilization figures remain undisclosed.
key_facts: SMIC North acquisition deal value: 40.6 billion yuan
Transaction cleared regulatory review for STAR Market restructuring
SMIC is a primary BCD process foundry for PMIC supply

implications.text: Merger reduces fragmentation of SMIC's BCD capacity footprint; supply chain must adapt to unified operational structure and potential fab rationalization.
Consolidation may simplify PMIC allocation logic but poses short-term disruption risk during integration; no capacity expansion announced.
Post-merger restructuring could enable cost rationalization, but no pricing guidance given; BOM impact uncertain pending integration details.

ko.counterpoint: Headline does not specify BCD node capacity figures, utilization rates, or automotive/server-grade certification implications; strategic impact on PMIC supply remains preliminary.
